fact: PeeringDB's record, last updated 2026-05-13, lists the Lesotho Internet Exchange Point (LIXP) in Maseru, run by the Internet Exchange Point Association of Lesotho, with 3 peers, 3 connections, all open-policy, and 30G total declared capacity; Econet Telecom Lesotho is one of the peers.

The Lesotho Internet Exchange Point (LIXP), hosted at the Lesotho Communications Authority in Maseru, was officially relaunched after a revamp reported on 2026-02-02, with the LCA saying it hosts five ISPs and two content delivery networks (unnamed); the exchange was founded in 2011, stopped, and resumed in 2016.
